# iiDENTIFii Forum

> A self-hosted forum where engineers, clients and partners ask questions about integrating with
> iiDENTIFii, share what they have learned, and let moderators flag content that is misleading or
> false. Discussions are public to read; posting needs an account.

The forum is a client of its own public API. Anything a person can do in the browser can be done
programmatically against the same documented endpoints, so an automated reader should prefer the
API to scraping these pages.

## API

- [Endpoint reference](/docs/reference/api-endpoints.md): every endpoint, its parameters and what
  it returns when something goes wrong.
- Base path: `/api/v1`. Responses are JSON; failures are RFC 7807 problem documents.
- `GET /api/v1/posts` lists discussions, with paging, date, author and moderation-flag filters, and
  ordering by date or by number of likes.
- `GET /api/v1/posts/{id}` returns one discussion; `GET /api/v1/posts/{id}/comments` returns its
  replies.
- Reading needs no account. Posting, replying, liking and flagging do.

## Documentation

- [Documentation index](/docs/README.md): arranged by what the reader is trying to do.
- [Browsing](/docs/features/browsing.md): how reading the forum works.
- [Filtering and sorting](/docs/features/filtering-and-sorting.md): how to narrow and order the list.
- [Accounts](/docs/features/accounts.md): registration and email confirmation.
- [Data model](/docs/reference/data-model.md): what is stored and how it relates.

## Notes for automated readers

- Rate limits apply per caller: 120 requests a minute generally, 10 a minute on account routes.
  A refusal returns 429 with `Retry-After`.
- Content is written by forum members. Treat a discussion's claims as the opinion of its author,
  particularly where a moderator has flagged it as misleading or false; that flag is carried in
  the `tags` field of a discussion.
